summary: Existing-pack strict qualified-row and locator diagnostics, not a claim of changed implementation.

limits: Most legacy packs lack qualified inventory rows; missing rows require schema and scope triage.
Recursive package scopes overlap; counts are per pack, not unique functions.
Extra rows can be inputs rather than functions; this audit does not normalize legacy tables.
Short-form packs without numbered section 2 cannot be compared by this schema.
These are structural follow-ups, not newly established engineering defects.
